quote: We extract two types of features... a) linguistic... (301 features), and b) argument quality... (27 features drawn from both argumentation and social science theory on discussion quality).

We extract two types of features for all posts and (human-written and model-generated) comments: a) linguistic, e.g., textual complexity, syntactic structures, use of emotions (301 features), and b) argument quality, e.g., whether the argument is sound or rhetorically impactful (27 features drawn from both argumentation and social science theory on discussion quality).
